what: rawilimo and abel rest from Google Flow and Gemini web media for 14 days (Flow kept answering them PUBLIC_ERROR_UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY and the daily re-probe after each 24 h wall added a strike every time; mish was disabled by Google after the same pattern); hypothesis: with no attempts for two weeks Google's risk score recovers and both return to full normal use

Run `gemini-web status rawilimo` and `gemini-web status abel` once (Flow Music was never checked on them; exit 4 names its missing one-time step, which the owner agreed to have done for him on 2026-10-06 for loiyehor and tronjhon). what: Sonnet 5.5 (medium, the table default) instead of Opus for two fixer classes (Egor, 2026-10-12): claudeb fixers of fit and legacy review rounds launched with no explicit model run sonnet (bugs-round fixers stay on Opus), and doctor-fix Speed runs alternate sonnet, opus, sonnet... per launch in area order; hypothesis: Sonnet lands as many fixes with no more reverts and no more confirmed findings on its fixes than Opus, at lower spend
